description: Zeek logs (zeek/<case>/<capture>/<log>.json): evidence time from ts (ISO8601 or epoch), event.dataset from the log name, labels.case/labels.item from the path, ECS endpoint copies from the conn 4-tuple, network.bytes on conn records. Native Zeek fields stay in place, except the three whose names collide with ECS objects or with other logs: files/weird `source` (a string) → zeek.log_source, ocsp/pe `id` (a file id string, where every other log has the id.orig_h/... tuple) → zeek.file_id, http `host` (the Host header) → url.domain. http.log arrives nested under zeek_http (see filebeat.yml) and is hoisted first.

script.description: http.log ships nested under zeek_http with its dotted column names intact (Filebeat would clobber a top-level `host`): hoist every column to the root, expanding id.orig_h-style names into objects, and move the Host header to url.domain
script.source: Map m = (Map) ctx.remove('zeek_http'); for (e in m.entrySet()) { String k = e.getKey(); def v = e.getValue(); if (k == 'host') { if (!(ctx.url instanceof Map)) { ctx.url = [:]; } ctx.url.domain = v; continue; } String[] parts = k.splitOnToken('.'); Map cur = ctx; for (int i = 0; i < parts.length - 1; i++) { if (!(cur[parts[i]] instanceof Map)) { cur[parts[i]] = [:]; } cur = (Map) cur[parts[i]]; } cur[parts[parts.length - 1]] = v; }

rename.description: ocsp.log/pe.log carry a STRING id (the Zeek file id of the analysed object); every other log's id is the orig_h/orig_p/resp_h/resp_p tuple, which the component template pins as an object
files.log/weird.log carry a native STRING source (e.g. HTTP) that collides with the ECS source object; move it aside before the endpoint copies

grok.description: zeek/<case>/<capture>/<log>.json: the case and the capture the record came from

script.description: conn: network.bytes = orig_ip_bytes + resp_ip_bytes (the connection's IP-level total, what the dashboards sum)
script.source: long b = 0; if (ctx.orig_ip_bytes != null) { b += ((Number) ctx.orig_ip_bytes).longValue(); } if (ctx.resp_ip_bytes != null) { b += ((Number) ctx.resp_ip_bytes).longValue(); } if (ctx.network == null) { ctx.network = new HashMap(); } if (ctx.network.bytes == null) { ctx.network.bytes = b; }
